title: Weather
seo_title: Kindergarten Weather Worksheets: Sunny, Rainy, Snowy and Weather Charts
standard_text: Use and share observations of local weather conditions to describe patterns over time.
meta_desc: Free kindergarten science worksheets on weather (NGSS K-ESS2-1): weather words, what to wear, weekly weather charts and patterns over time. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Sunny, cloudy, rainy, snowy or windy. Charts show patterns.
body_html:
How to think about it

Look at the sky every day.

  • Weather can be sunny, cloudy, rainy, snowy or windy.
  • A chart shows patterns.
  • Summer is warm. Winter is cold.
Example

The picture shows rain. What is the weather?

Look at the picture.

Answer: rainy

Example

Is the morning or the afternoon warmer?

The sun warms the air all day.

Answer: the afternoon

Common mistakes

  • Thinking it snows in summer.
  • Thinking mornings are warmer than afternoons.
  • Counting only some of the days on the chart.

faq.q: What kinds of weather are there?
faq.a: Sunny, cloudy, rainy, snowy, windy and stormy.
Afternoons are usually warmer than mornings, and summer is warmer than winter. Snow comes in winter.

faq.q: How do you make a weather chart?
faq.a: Each day, look outside and draw or stamp the weather. At the end of the week, count each kind.
